name: ops
description: Ops. The Nucleus front door and its upkeep. /cos takes a request in plain language and routes it to the installed workflow that does it, splitting a request that spans several areas into parallel pieces. Also /status (is everything wired up), /diagnose (troubleshooting), /register-schedules (scheduled tasks and their run receipts), /test-connectors, and agent-run metrics. Owns no business domain of its own; configure with /setup-core.
